title: Tuberculous meningitis
dek: A CNS emergency: start therapy on a high prior, add steroids, delay ART 4–8 weeks if HIV. Standard HRZE is the WHO DS backbone; DR-TBM is not automatic BPaLM.
story: Tuberculous meningitis presents as subacute meningitis with basal enhancement, hydrocephalus, and cranial-nerve palsies. Mortality and disability are high. Do not wait for a perfect CSF WRD if the prior is high: treat, then confirm. Ultra on CSF plus a large-volume culture is the lab spine; a negative NAAT does not exclude TBM.

WHO: DS-TBM is treated with first-line drugs for at least 6 months (many national overlays still use 9–12). Adjunctive dexamethasone or prednisolone tapered over 6–8 weeks is a strong recommendation. HIV: delay ART 4–8 weeks. Drug-resistant TBM needs drugs that actually enter CSF (FQ, LZD, INH, PZA, some rifamycin at adequate exposure) — pretomanid/BPaLM evidence in TBM is not the pulmonary trial.

Pediatric Cape Town-style intensified regimens (higher RIF/INH/PZA, ethionamide instead of EMB) appear in WHO child-TBM discussions. Adult intensified RIF (higher IV doses) is trial territory; do not freelance 35 mg/kg without a protocol.
deep: INH, PZA, LZD, levofloxacin: decent CSF. EMB and AMK: poor. Rifampin CSF fractions are low — another reason intensified RIF is researched.
Hydrocephalus may need EVD/shunt. Hyponatraemia is cerebral salt wasting or SIADH — different water prescriptions.
Paradoxical worsening on treatment can be IRIS or infarct. Imaging beats swapping to MDR empirically without a DST trigger.
Pregnancy does not forbid TBM therapy; it forbids forgetting steroids and a real rifamycin.

visual.caption: TBM clock: treat + steroids immediately, DST in parallel, ART delayed if HIV. Do not wait on culture to start.

example.title: HIV, CD4 40, basal meningitis, Ultra CSF trace
example.setup: Adult, HIV, CD4 40, 10 days of fever and diplopia. CSF Ultra trace, RIF indeterminate. Team wants ART today and BPaLM today.

steps.title: Treat TBM now with steroids
steps.body: Trace in naive CSF is not relic DNA from a 2018 lung. Start a CNS-penetrating regimen; RIF is uncalled — hunt a better DST (repeat CSF, extra-neural WRD, tNGS).

steps.title: Do not start ART today
steps.body: 4–8 week delay. Steroids are not optional.

steps.title: BPaLM is not automatic
steps.body: Indeterminate RIF is not RR. If RR is proven, pulmonary BPaLM evidence is thin for TBM — expert DR-TBM construction with CSF-penetrating agents.

example.takeaway: TBM: immediate TB drugs + steroids; delayed ART; DST without delaying the first dose.

choices: Dexamethasone or prednisolone tapered over 6–8 weeks
IGRA-guided ART the same day in all TBM
check.answer: Dexamethasone or prednisolone tapered over 6–8 weeks
check.why: Steroids save lives in TBM. ART delay is the HIV-specific extra.

check.why: EMB/AMK are poor CSF drugs; that changes DR-TBM construction.
